purpose: Read-only bundled product roadmap grouped into completed, active-focus, next and future initiatives.
primaryGoal: Understand shipped capabilities and potential priorities without treating the roadmap as a release schedule or live deployment evidence.

dataSources.name: Bundled roadmapItems and phase metadata
dataSources.behavior: 17 static initiatives, 98 feature bullets, phases ordered done/current/next/future. useMemo groups entries and derives six count metrics; no roadmap query, mutation, export, workspace vehicle or date filter.

dataSources.name: Formatting preferences, not roadmap availability
dataSources.behavior: Shared settings query ['settings'], five-minute staleTime, refetchOnMount always, retry 1. Summary counts use existing operational metric formatting; settings availability is independent of the static roadmap.
dataSources.backendVerification: Not inspected: no backend capability or runtime endpoint acceptance claimed.

dataSources.name: Localized labels and document title
dataSources.behavior: Phase labels, descriptions, overview and newer entry IDs use translation keys with fallbacks; the first five entries bypass translation. usePageTitle sets and restores the title through titleStore.

components.name: PageLayout
components.behavior: Existing PageContainer adapter; full-width min-w-0 container, vertical gap-6; do not replace shell or introduce selectors.

components.name: SystemSummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.behavior: Six formatted source count metrics, source availability and observation-time caveat, description/provenance, Review details and shared Drawer.

components.name: CompositionRail
components.behavior: Proportional track plus readable legend; caller owns denominator. Zero-count phases hide only fill, not legend.

components.name: GlassPanel, IconBox, SectionTitle, PanelTitle, Text
components.behavior: Existing surfaces, typography and icon boxes; headings resolve to h2/h3. IconBox uses neonColorMap bg/ring/text.

components.name: FadeIn, StaggerContainer, StaggerItem
components.behavior: Existing motion-preference integration; FadeIn suppresses delay and entrance under reduce, StaggerContainer collapses staggering, StaggerItem uses final hidden geometry when reduced.

components.name: EmptyState
components.behavior: Localized empty-total and empty-phase explanations; no API recovery action is appropriate for bundled source entries.

components.name: PhaseChip, RoadmapCard, DeliveryProgress, PhaseSection
components.behavior: One exported page with four private helpers; domain grouping is appropriate locally, chip chrome overlaps Badge.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: PhaseChip rebuilds rounded status-pill, decorative dot and text; the phase-count pill repeats similar bg/ring/text chrome at lines 485-486. Existing Badge provides semantic variants, dot, sizes and forced-colors border.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse Badge with explicit phase-to-existing-variant mapping and localized label/count; keep phase semantics, icons and zero counts. No universal roadmap status registry.

sourceBehavior.detail: Cards reflow 1 column -> md 2 -> xl 3 -> 3xl 4; every phase and feature list remains rendered.
Progress stacks below lg; lg introduces row layout and a fixed lg:w-56 label block; rail retains min-w-0.
Phase header wraps; explanation uses w-full until sm.
Compact metric grid uses 1 column, sm 2, md 3 and 1920px 6; Review details is retained.

issues.detail: Card heading row has no wrap/stack breakpoint; a shrink-0 phase chip competes with a shrink-0 icon box and long translated title/description inside overflow-hidden. Narrow allocated containers may squeeze text; source risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: At compact container sizes stack/reflow chip and title while retaining full descriptions, feature bullets and phase identification; validate all ten specified widths and long translations.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: Unverified at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560; no browser or screenshot exercised.

sourceStrengths: PhaseSection uses localized section aria-label at page line 479; SectionTitle and PanelTitle use h2/h3 in Typography.tsx:29-33,107-108.
Feature lists use ul/li at page lines 389-396; decorative phase dots, icons and blur are aria-hidden.
CompositionRail.tsx:59-61 supplies role=img and caller-localized summary; lines 81-105 retain a readable list legend and details for every phase.
OperationalBrief.tsx:127 and 155-166 supplies named overview section and native shared Review details button; Drawer open/onClose at lines 234-240.
Shared motion preference support exists in inspected motion files; runtime reduced-motion behavior is not claimed.

issues.detail: Phase/count text and repeated status icons use fixed toned color classes from neonColorMap rather than light/dark semantic variants. Contrast on actual surfaces is unknown; this is not a measured AA failure.
issues.fix: Use existing semantic Badge and theme-aware foreground tokens; measure effective text/UI contrast in light/dark/custom/forced-colors modes.

accessibility.keyboardFocusScreenReaderContrastTouch: Unverified; source inspection does not establish drawer focus trap/restoration, keyboard usability, target reachability or contrast.

states.dataKind: Bundled editorial source, not remote roadmap state.
states.initialLoading: No roadmap fetch. Summary renders available immediately; shared formatting preferences may fetch independently.
states.empty: DeliveryProgress handles total===0 at lines 436-438; each PhaseSection handles empty list at lines 494-497 while retaining the phase heading. Current static source has entries in all phases.
states.error: No roadmap network error/retry or mutation. Shared settings fallback/query states are not roadmap failure.
states.offlineStaleUnknown: Bundled content remains source-renderable; summary explicitly says not live deployment/release telemetry at line 554. SystemSummaryBrief.tsx:27 defaults observation time to unknown; no roadmap freshness timestamp is invented.
states.partial: Independent phase bands are not gated behind remote data.
states.runtimeAcceptance: All state render behavior unexercised; only branches and source wiring inspected.

issues.detail: Completed-phase description claims availability 'in your deployment today', although roadmap is bundled and summary correctly disclaims live deployment evidence. This text cannot be treated as verified deployment telemetry.
issues.fix: Preserve completed-phase content and shipped capabilities, but reconcile deployment wording with the existing static-source caveat; do not add fabricated deployment status or remove initiatives.

visualIssues.detail: Every RoadmapCard adds an absolute 128px neon-colored opacity-10 blur-3xl circle. One source decoration replicates across 17 cards; it carries no data and is explicitly aria-hidden.
visualIssues.fix: Remove this ambient glow, retaining all card text, icons, phase labels and sections; use existing neutral GlassPanel surface/elevation.

visualIssues.detail: Progress fill uses saturated neonColorMap dot utilities, as do chip dots and count/icon accents (lines 348-352,364,379,475-486). tokens.ts:21-25 confirms green/cyan/purple/amber neon backgrounds/rings and fixed toned text. The glow field from the token map is not consumed here.
visualIssues.fix: Retain all four labelled phases and proportional data, but choose restrained existing semantic/theme tokens through current component props; avoid neon escalation or new palette/engine.

architectureIssues.detail: Titles/descriptions/features translate only when item.id exists. The first five entries at lines 95-175 have no id, so five titles, five descriptions and 43 feature bullets remain hardcoded English through lines 382-393.
architectureIssues.fix: Retain every original string and order; assign stable localization identities and coordinate canonical catalog additions with the catalog owner. Do not derive IDs from translated titles or duplicate catalogs.

architectureIssues.detail: Indirect summary preference query uses queryFn:getSettings; api/settings.ts:24 has no signal parameter. The separate api/hooks/useSettings.ts:30 forwards signal, but it is not the hook used by this page's formatting bridge.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared settings owner should reconcile the existing preference bridge and cancellation without changing query key, retry/stale policy, raw settings, defaults or subscriptions. Do not migrate settings globally in this page task.

priority.rationale: Preservation-friendly static page already uses shared layout, operational summary, composition rail and motion; confirmed glow/neon and localization gaps are bounded. Compact heading layout and actual accessibility need runtime review, not a claimed failure.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Canonical roadmap localization coverage
requiredSharedChanges.existingOwnerFile: web\src\locales (canonical catalog owner; exact language files not inspected)
requiredSharedChanges.detail: First five bundled entries bypass localization.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Coordinate canonical title/description/feature keys with stable page entry IDs; preserve all 43 existing bullets and fallback strings.
dependsOn: Stable nonlocalized IDs for first five entries

requiredSharedChanges.name: Existing settings preference bridge cancellation
requiredSharedChanges.detail: Formatting bridge uses a signal-less settings read, unlike the existing API hook.
requiredSharedChanges.fix: Forward the QueryFunctionContext abort signal through existing getSettings/request contract; preserve all current preference behavior and policies.
dependsOn: Existing request cancellation contract; not inspected beyond call site

competingImplementations.name: Phase status chrome
competingImplementations.decision: Reuse Badge; keep domain phase mapping local. No shared new component required.

competingImplementations.name: Settings reads
competingImplementations.decision: Shared-owner reconciliation only; do not change the page's settings defaults/policies to obtain cancellation.

competingImplementations.name: Progress/layout/summary
competingImplementations.decision: Already existing CompositionRail, PageLayout and SystemSummaryBrief/OperationalBrief. Reuse their existing props; no competing rail, stats grid, overlay or layout proposal.

actions.name: Review details
actions.behavior: Open existing Drawer containing narrative, six metrics and Attention information; preserve source scope, observation caveat and provenance.

actions.name: Close overview details
actions.behavior: Existing Drawer onClose resets detailsOpen; shared focus/Escape behavior not exercised.

dataBehavior: Keep 17 initiative titles/descriptions/icons, all 98 feature strings and original within-phase ordering; listed capabilities are editorial content, not audited implementation claims.
Keep counts done=10,current=1,next=2,future=4,total=17,featuresShipped=70; counts are initiative-based, not feature completion percentages.
Keep progress widths count/total*100, every phase legend/detail, zero-fill omission and empty-total fallback.
Keep all four phase descriptions, roadmap subtitle, no-release-schedule note, bundled-source scope, unknown observation-time caveat and six raw count metrics.
Retain localized text/fallbacks, document-title cleanup, shared formatting preferences and reduced-motion integration; no physical SI measurements are transformed by this page.
No page mutation, navigation link, export, chart zoom, selection or persistence setting exists to remove; overview Drawer is a real inherited action.

evidenceLimits.auditType: Phase0 source-only; no source edits, Git, full-repository lint/build or runtime testing.
unverified: All viewport widths and allocated containers
Actual deployment availability of bundled completed initiatives
evidenceLimits.countEvidence: Executed inline Node fs.readFileSync plus matchAll against only the assigned page; exit 0. Extracted 17 entries / 98 bullets / 70 completed bullets. Counts are source occurrences, not rendered acceptance.
evidenceLimits.failedProbe: Initial PowerShell regex-count command failed with ParserError (exit 1, unexpected token ']'); replaced by successful bounded inline Node source count.
evidenceLimits.notRun: audit.sh was read but not executed because its mandatory project TypeScript step exceeds the assignment's source-only/no-full-validation scope. No tsc, lint, build or tests claimed.
evidenceLimits.dependencyReadLimits: Only imported presentation/formatting owners and bounded directly related settings comparison inspected. GlassPanel/EmptyState/category-barrel internals, locale catalogs, shared overlay internals, settings backend and metric formatter internals remain uninspected.
